Is your bio too long? ✍️ Count characters as you type.

1. Open 315tools.com/text (Character counter)
2. Type or paste your text. The numbers update live
3. Set a limit, like 150 for a bio, and see how many are left

Free · No sign-up · Your text never leaves your device ✅
